warnings: PNG contains two portrait sheets rotated 90 degrees within one landscape scan; programmatically cropped to left/right halves and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise to read. This file is the physical LEFT half (the higher-numbered sheet, แผ่นที่ 4/21), paired with แผ่นที่ 3/21 (หมวดงานโครงสร้าง continued, RIGHT half) extracted as _1.json.

Confirmed at 3x zoom: items 2.1-2.8 are printed as a bold number+text string wholly inside the รายการ (description) column -- the ลำดับที่ column itself is blank for these rows (only the top-level '2' header has its own ลำดับที่ entry). This is visually and structurally different from this same variant's หมวดที่ 3 rollup sheet (แผ่นที่ 13/21), where 3.1/3.2/3.3 print in their own separate ลำดับที่ column cells -- both are transcribed exactly as printed, not normalized to match each other.

This is a rollup/pointer sheet: all 8 sub-category rows and the grand-total row have blank จำนวน/ราคา/จำนวนเงิน columns, unit 'รวม' only -- detail and quantities for each 2.x sub-category are on the following sheets (แผ่นที่ 5/21 onward). Transcribed as null, not invented.
All unit-price/amount columns are blank in the source for every row on this sheet -- transcribed as null, not invented.
